fluff.overview: After the Jihad stripped many elite units to fill battle armor companies, the LCAF recognized that conventional infantry remained essential for roles that battle armor could not cost-effectively fill. Motorized platoons add light transport vehicles to standard infantry formations, giving them the speed to conduct rapid strikes, screening operations, and quick withdrawals that foot infantry cannot manage. Configured for civil disturbance management, these platoons carry sonic stunners for crowd suppression and grenade launchers that can deliver tear gas, smoke, or fragmentation rounds depending on the threat level.
